name: lookup
description: Resolve a MAC address or OUI prefix to its registered organization using longest-prefix match across the MA-L, MA-M, MA-S, IAB, and CID registries. Reports the block type, address count, registration country, and a link to the full record page. Randomized and locally administered addresses usually have no registered organization.

arguments.name: mac
arguments.desc: MAC address or OUI prefix, 6 to 12 hex characters. Accepts colon, hyphen, Cisco dot, or plain hex, for example 8C:1F:64:AF:A4:B2 or 8C1F64.
